systems.owner: Ministry of Health, with World Bank financing and ANINF technical support
systems.tiers: health centres in four pilot health departments of Ngounié (Mbigou, Malinga, Mimongo, Mandji-Ndoulou), read remotely at the Centre hospitalier régional de Mouila; installation from 15 April 2026

note: The deployment described under the eGabon-SIS name is tele-ultrasound kits in health centres, a telemedicine kit of class enabling, which gives no fact; nothing is said of reporting or of patient records.
